author: jedu2026
quote: Pros:The game is huge, wherever you go there is something to do and it's filled up with a lot of detail. My jaw dropped when I realised there's even entire cartoons to watch on TV, and the side missions are also super interesting with sometimes funny outcomes.Cons:For a new entry it falls behind GTA5 in many ways removing features like selection of episodes. The story is the blandest it can possibly get and short as well. It lasts around 7 hours for the main story and I remember people hyping **** game also released in a poor state, those 13 years were definitelly not well spent if it's running at less than 30 and there's glitches and bugs everywhere.Birds have become my worst enemy, they fly mpt even close but it seems they hit me anyways. they just kinda die in the air and push me off the road or increase my stars.Also it seems like Metacritic is manipulating people's reviews. Just for future proof, my score is a 4

author: jedu2026
quote: El remake de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time para Nintendo Switch 2 logra lo que parecía imposible: modernizar la obra maestra más influyente de la historia sin perder un ápice de su magia original. Hyrule luce más vivo y épico que nunca gracias a una reconstrucción gráfica impresionante en 4K y 60 fps fluidos, con iluminación dinámica que transforma desde el tranquilo Bosque Kokiri hasta el sombrío Templo de las **** controles renovados hacen que apuntar con el arco, usar el gancho y combatir con la Espada Maestra sea una auténtica delicia, mientras que la banda sonora reorquestada pone la piel de gallina en cada melodía. Una carta de amor inolvidable tanto para veteranos como para quienes viajan en el tiempo por primera vez.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
